summary: This Makefile snippet checks whether a Docker container named 'sonarqube' already exists. If it doesn't, it creates a new one from the latest sonarqube image. If it does exist, it ensures the container is started, silencing any output or errors.

explanations.1: The shell command `docker ps -a -q -f name=sonarqube` lists container IDs matching the name 'sonarqube'; if the result is empty, the `ifeq` condition is true and we proceed to create the container.
explanations.6: The `-@` prefix means 'ignore errors (the dash) and don't print the command itself (the at sign)', so failed start attempts won't break the build; the `> /dev/null 2>&1` redirects all output and errors to nowhere, keeping things quiet.
